title: DECISION: Do not hold store lock during network probe in discovery loop
description: Lock is acquired only for the upsert operation, not held during probe_peer (network I/O). Rationale: avoids blocking other JMAP requests (Message/get, Chat/query, etc.) on network latency. Correct atomicity: the race between discovery and user action is acceptable — discovery is eventual, and the contact data converges via periodic re-probing.
